patch.detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-local finder). getDensityCity and getCityHub build a city from getPublicCircles and getPublicEvents only, while spaces.city is filled (Encinitas x6, Carlsbad, Vista) and migration 20270302000000 still says the public place surfaces do not read it. Local businesses, studios and organizations are the strongest local-intent entities the site has, and the city pages neither link nor mark them up. THE FIX: add `spaces` to DensityCity and CityHub, read networked Spaces once (listNetworkedSpaces, with `city` added to its projection) and filter on citySlug(s.city), render a 'Local Spaces in <city>' grid with SpaceCard, and add an ItemList of them to the JsonLd array.

CLOSED 2026-10-05: listNetworkedSpaces (lib/spaces/discovery.ts) now projects spaces.city onto NetworkedSpace.city; getDensityCity (app/discover/cities/_data.ts) and getCityHub (app/discover/places/_data.ts) read it once, fail-safe, and filter on citySlug; both city pages render a Local Spaces in <city> grid of SpaceCard with a spaceListSchema ItemList in the JsonLd array. A Space never creates a city hub or sitemap URL on its own, so the index sets are unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");if(!/SpaceCard/.test(fs.readFileSync("app/discover/cities/[citySlug]/page.tsx","utf8"))){console.error("SCAN-675: the city landing page lists the Circles and events in a city and none of the Spaces (businesses, studios, organizations) located there, though spaces.city is filled (Encinitas x6, Carlsbad, Vista); local businesses are the strongest local-intent entities the site has.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
